## Research questions

- **RQ1 (quality)**: How does pure graph-rank scoring compare with the hybrid
  rank+TF-IDF scorer on ranking quality (MAP@10, nDCG@10)?
- **RQ2 (latency)**: What is the end-to-end query latency profile (p50/p95/p99)?
- **RQ3 (update economics)**: What does an online rank update cost vs
  re-embedding?
- **RQ4 (determinism)**: Is the pipeline replayable (byte-identical ranks)?
- **RQ5 (memory)**: What is the footprint of integer ranks vs $d$-dim float
  vectors?

## E1 — pipeline verification (done)

Unit + integration tests green across `terraphim_automata` and
`terraphim_rolegraph`; hybrid path exercised by 5 dedicated TF-IDF unit
tests. Indicative criterion sweep (see
`docs/research/paper-bench-evidence-20260926/`): autocomplete 1.6–2.8 µs;
FST exact match 631 ns; index build ~linear; end-to-end query 0.8–2.7 ms.
